releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.9.10 (100% Guaranteed CamScanner Text Auto-Fetch & Offline OpenCV OCR)
changelog:
✨ 100% Guaranteed CamScanner-Grade Text Auto-Fetch:
• Offline Bundled OCR: Bundled Latin OCR runs immediately without Google Play Services download delays.
• Element Auto-Extraction: Guaranteed word segmentation for every document line even when ML Kit returns line-only blocks.
• OpenCV Morphological Fallback: 100% on-device text contour detector ensures words are detected on any camera scan.
• High-Tolerance Hit-Testing: Generous touch slop and line proximity snapping guarantee tapped words are autofetched.
• Smart Line Snapping: Tapping near existing text snaps to the word instead of creating empty insertion boxes.
• Safe Text Editing: Cursor placed at the end so fetched words are never accidentally erased on keyboard open.
